reviews.text: Our experience with Nano has been perfect. Woody is an adopted dog with many fears and insecurities who didn't enjoy walks and struggled to stay home alone. After several attempts, we found what we were looking for in Nano: a trainer who could help us understand Woody and work with him using love and positive reinforcement. After a few months of training with Nano, he has improved incredibly; he's a much more balanced and happy dog.

Since Blue came into our lives, we've been committed to teaching him what he needs for a healthy mental balance and optimal behavior with other dogs and humans. Thanks to Nano's great work, this is becoming a reality!
Thank you so much!!

A great experience thanks to Nano! He explains everything very clearly and it's obvious he loves dogs (Tyson loves him too). We're gradually getting our dog to make our walks much more relaxed. THANK YOU NANO!!!
Nano is a wonderful person, passionate about dogs, and in every class he demonstrates his empathy and love for the animal world. We couldn't be happier.
Nano was fantastic. He helped my dog ​​Pepe overcome his fear and gave us guidelines for further training. He was wonderful with Pepe and with us. A true professional. Highly recommended.
Excellent professional, lovely human being, my dog ​​loves him and I would hire his services a thousand times over.

Bruce has become a super good and calm dog thanks to Nano!!
It's wonderful learning from him, both my dog ​​and I!

Soho's journey began with Nano, his trainer, the day he arrived home and we knew absolutely nothing about how to handle him. Thanks to his training, Soho is a calm, well-balanced Australian Shepherd and a fantastic companion.

We contacted Nano to teach us how to train our puppy, and the experience with him has been truly wonderful and enriching. We've greatly improved our relationship with our puppy, learned how to manage her emotions, and, above all, her needs.

Thank you so much for everything! We'll see you again!

We are so proud that Nano helped us with our first steps with our puppy, showing us how to handle certain situations and the right way to act. We learned a lot and, above all, had a lot of fun. Nela was the happiest dog every time you came to see us! She'll miss you, and we hope to see you soon.
Thank you, Nano, for helping us. You taught us very well and explained how things work with a puppy because we had no idea. Very professional, I highly recommend your work ✨✨

From the very first call, the potential was clear. Nano has been a true professional from the start. He dedicates time to even a simple consultation and explains his working methods in great detail. That's enough to motivate you to start working with him!
Vespa is a mixed-breed foster dog with a touch of Stafy and a lot of reactivity, and with Nano, in just a few sessions, her reactivity has decreased significantly.

Not only has he managed to reduce her reactivity (making socialization, walks, and other routine activities much more enjoyable for Vespa and me), but she's also become a super obedient and well-trained dog who practically does somersaults.

However, I think the most important thing is how he connects with the animal. After her first session, Vespa was already eagerly awaiting the following week. And so was I, I won't lie.

We haven't seen Nano in a while, not by choice, but because we've moved to a different city (although I'll try to get him to travel so he can continue helping Vespa, haha).

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for how you do your job, how much you enjoy it, and the time and quality you dedicate to it. This is definitely a difficult time for us.

I hope we see you again soon, and thank you so much!

P.S. The photos speak for themselves (the intensity and the love).
Highly recommended!!! Indispensable help, definitely another friend of Blue ☺️

Thanks to Nano, in just two months Oreo went from being an adorable but very impulsive puppy to being incredibly obedient and calm when needed. In our case, we wanted more obedience and self-control at home, and with Nano's advice and practical experience, we can say we've more than achieved our goal! Thank you for everything! Highly recommended. He has a special connection with animals.
The best experience ever! Nano is a very patient and flexible professional, he adapts to our needs, and we are very happy with the results and Nit's progress. Highly recommended!

Fernando has a special talent for connecting with dogs and their owners. He's an excellent person and an excellent professional. He's a sure bet if you want to train your dog in an easy, enjoyable, and effective way.

Nano is a true professional. I contacted him because my dog ​​was still having accidents in the house, and he solved the problem in the same call. I wish we all had his professional ethics. I will definitely contact him again if I have any problems in the future. Thank you from the bottom of my heart!
Today Nano came to our house to help us with our dogs...we were very happy with the results...A GREAT PROFESSIONAL...Thank you so much, Nano!!
